## Cleric

- **Schools:** Restoration, Holy

| bless | 5 | 30 | +40 max HP, 5m |

## Warlock

A pact-bound dominator who bends minds to their will and drains the life from those who resist.

- **Primary stat:** Intelligence
- **Schools:** Domination, Shadow

| Spell | Lvl | EP | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| charm | 1 | 35 | beguile the living |
| control undead | 1 | 35 | subdue undead |
| shadow bolt | 1 | 12 | 6–13 shadow dmg (×INT) |
| drain | 5 | 28 | 14–26 shadow dmg (×INT), heals 50% |
